chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet cold entrance: wind-like noise breath, a low F pedal, then one lone bell note rings out and is answered by silence}
positive_styles: F minor with suspended sus2 and sus4 chords
lone bell-like pulse-wave lead melody with long held notes and rests, a call answered by silence
very slow glassy suspended arpeggio, low in the mix
low tonic pedal bass, almost still
muffled heartbeat drum, a soft kick on beat one and a faint pulse after beat three
cold, sparse, lonely frozen canyon at night, a small warm lamp against the wind

chunks.text:
